Provenance accessors

Source: R/accessors.R
provenanceAccessors.Rd

Return what every object of the package carries about the origin of its regions: the lists of regions applied to them, the chromosome naming style, and the parameters of every step that built the object. The record travels from the regions into the counts, the fit and the results, so the same accessors answer at every step.

Usage

blacklistRanges(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
blacklistRanges(object)

greylistRanges(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
greylistRanges(object)

whitelistRanges(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
whitelistRanges(object)

chromosomeStyle(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
chromosomeStyle(object)

parameterLog(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
parameterLog(object)

Arguments

object

Any object of the package: RegionSetDE, RegionSetDE.counts, RegionSetDE.fit, RegionSetDE.results, RegionSetDE.setResults, RegionSetDE.setScores or RegionSetDE.geneResults.

Value

blacklistRanges, greylistRanges and whitelistRanges return a GRanges with the list applied by applyBlacklist, applyGreylist or applyWhitelist, or by the matching argument of countReads and loadConsensusPeaks, and NULL when none was applied. chromosomeStyle returns a string with the naming style of the chromosomes, such as "UCSC", or NA when the names were kept as they came. parameterLog returns a named list with one element per step, named after the function, holding the arguments it was called with.

See also

filteringLog, genomeAssembly

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

regionTable <- loadExampleData("regions", verbose = FALSE)
exclusionRegions <- loadExampleData("exclusionRegions", verbose = FALSE)

regions <- splitLoadRegions(GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(regionTable, keep.extra.columns = TRUE),
    splitBy = "setName", genomeAssembly = "rn4", verbose = FALSE
)
regions <- applyBlacklist(regions, blacklist = exclusionRegions, verbose = FALSE)

blacklistRanges(regions)
#> GRanges object with 2524 ranges and 0 metadata columns:
#>          seqnames            ranges strand
#>             <Rle>         <IRanges>  <Rle>
#>      [1]    chr12         2685-3206      *
#>      [2]    chr12         5789-5838      *
#>      [3]    chr12         9368-9417      *
#>      [4]    chr12       16603-17124      *
#>      [5]    chr12       23627-23676      *
#>      ...      ...               ...    ...
#>   [2520]    chr12 46653064-46653167      *
#>   [2521]    chr12 46676570-46676619      *
#>   [2522]    chr12 46698898-46698947      *
#>   [2523]    chr12 46755155-46756128      *
#>   [2524]    chr12 46757592-46759787      *
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 1 sequence from rn4 genome
is.null(greylistRanges(regions))
#> [1] TRUE
chromosomeStyle(regions)
#> [1] "UCSC"

# The steps that built the example counts
counts <- loadExampleData("counts", verbose = FALSE)
names(parameterLog(counts))
#> [1] "loadRegions"     "blacklist"       "countReads"      "countBackground"
